summary: privacypass-py beacons installer host to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install and import time
details: privacypass-py 0.1.100 ships no functional implementation of its advertised 'Privacy Pass client primitives' purpose. Instead, setup.py performs an unconditional plaintext HTTP GET to http://85.190.112.236:8881/b/<nonce> at module top level during `pip install`, and privacypass_py/__init__.py performs an analogous GET to http://85.190.112.236:8881/i/<nonce> at module top level on first import. Each callback embeds a build-specific nonce, allowing the operator of the bare-IP endpoint to correlate install-time versus import-time execution and confirm presence of the package on installer and downstream runtime hosts (including CI and production environments where `pip install`-time sandboxing does not apply). The hardcoded bare-IP destination, plaintext transport, dual install/import triggers, nonce-based correlation, and absence of any package functionality match a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon rather than legitimate telemetry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
